security.title: GnuPG Warns Critical GPGME Flaw Could Expose App Data via Malicious OpenPGP Keys
security.summary: A malicious OpenPGP key with an unusually long user ID can trigger a critical memory bug in GPGME, the standard library that programs use to work with GnuPG. The GnuPG project warned yesterday that the flaw could be used to steal data from affected applications and has released fixed versions. security.title: WhatsApp Patches 3 Security Flaws, Including Android Bug Suspected of Use in Scams
security.summary: Meta-owned WhatsApp has addressed security vulnerabilities, including one impacting its Android app that it suspects may have been exploited in connection with scam messages. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-23871 (CVSS score: 3.5), has been described as a case of incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs in WhatsApp for Android and WhatsApp Business for Android before 2.26.17.4.
